# Meridian Books

Meridian Books is a bookkeeping practice based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, serving clients remotely across Canada. It is an Ontario sole proprietorship founded by Mehrdad Kheirollahi, who has more than 20 years of experience.

## Services
- Monthly bookkeeping: recording and categorizing transactions, reconciling bank and credit-card accounts, and a short monthly summary.
- Catch-up and cleanup: a backlog of bookkeeping brought up to date for a fixed fee for a defined scope, quoted before work starts.
- Payroll support, where included in a client's agreed scope.
- GST/HST handling as part of the monthly books.
- Year-end preparation: a reconciled year-end file prepared for the client's own accountant. Meridian Books does not file taxes.

## Software
QuickBooks, Xero, Sage 50, and Excel. Work is done in the client's own file.

## Pricing
Monthly bookkeeping is a fixed retainer from $550/month + HST, month-to-month. Catch-up work is a fixed fee for a defined scope, quoted before work starts.
